casual: k-pop on loop while the render finishes. yes, all of it. no, he will not skip tracks.

#BRAND: He does not start with the logo. He starts with the question: what is this thing for? The logo comes later. In a sketchbook. Ugly at first. Right by page four.

#MOTION: Movement is punctuation. A good ease tells your eye where to go before you know it. He storyboards on paper. He animates in After Effects. He will not ship a curve he cannot explain out loud.

#OFFSCREEN: When the screen feels small, he paints. When painting feels quiet, he builds: a shelf, a lamp, a workbench. When the workshop gets loud, he cooks with no measurements. All of it feeds the work.

Section 02

Charges Filed

Eight counts. All true. He said "guilty" to all of them, quickly, like a professional.
Felony

§ 18-101 visual crimes

Stealing eyes

People stop and look. They forget to walk. He keeps their eyes for three seconds. Minimum.

Felony

§ 22-404 software abuse

Driving Adobe without a licence

He is too good at Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign and After Effects. Nobody gave him a permit. He did not wait for one.

Misd.

§ 09-118 kinetic offenses

Making still things move

Old logos sat still. Now they walk, spin and wink. Illegal. Also very cute.

Felony

§ 45-772 conspiracy

Meeting to make things pretty

He met designers, writers and printers. Together they made things better. On purpose. Many times.

Misd.

§ 03-221 public nuisance

Sketchbooks in public

40 full books. 11 pens. He draws strangers on trains. The strangers never know. We know.

Infr.

§ 61-009 property damage

Building furniture alone

A desk, a shelf, a lamp, a bike stand. Two had no instructions. Nothing fell down. Suspicious.

Infr.

§ 77-530 domestic arts

Cooking with no numbers

No cup. No scale. No recipe. Smoke alarm: sometimes. Bad food: never. Explain that.

Felony

§ 12-999 repeat offender

Moving things 1 pixel

Left 1px. Right 1px. Left again. At 2 a.m. He will not ship ugly things. We respect this. We also arrest for this.

Operation SKP: The 10-Series Archive

2025 . social media campaign &amp; visual series
RoleLead Social Campaign Designer &amp; Content Strategist
ClientShri Krishna Pickles (SKP)
Timeline4 months, 2 towns
ToolsAdobe Illustrator, Photoshop

The story

The digital streets were quiet, so a 10-part tactical campaign was deployed across social feeds to intercept hungry scrollers.

Instead of repeating the same visual formula, ten distinct creative series were engineered—ranging from product close-ups and spice-route lore to meme-ops and motion cards—all locked under one unified brand syndicate.
